description: The derivational move for qou-qnnq. theta_K is not a search target: DeltaLambdaT5Assembly defines it as Im(u(q0)), the imaginary part of the log meridian holonomy. FigureEightDeformedMeridianWinding proves sorry-free that the substrate-matched meridian has Im u = -2*pi*k, so theta_K is quantized in units of 2*pi — a derivation-side constraint independent of A_omega. Tested against the A-free curve: the k_mu = 0 rows are the first readings in the arc to pass the straddling necessary condition, then miss the ratio by >= 890x; common k = 0 is excluded by the measured sign flip. Conclusion is a FORK — either the T5 u is not the Murakami meridian, or the T4 thetas are incompatible with the proved quantization. Includes a coincidence guard against the (1,2) row's spurious 1.9% magnitude agreement. Nothing fitted.

data.verdict: ϑ_K WAS NEVER A SEARCH TARGET — THE CORPUS DEFINES IT. DeltaLambdaT5Assembly's `s_channel_at_substrate` gives S = A_omega*kappa*(Re^2 u - Im^2 u) with Re u = ln q0 proved, so theta_K = Im(u(q0)), the imaginary part of the LOG MERIDIAN HOLONOMY (the class field's own documentation). The ln^2 q0 - theta^2 shape is just Re^2 u - Im^2 u. Nine measured readings were spent hunting a quantity that was already defined two files away. AND THE DEFINITION IS TESTABLE, because FigureEightDeformedMeridianWinding PROVES sorry-free that the substrate-matched meridian is u = N*t - 2*pi*i*k, hence Im u = -2*pi*k: theta_K is QUANTIZED in units of 2*pi. That is a derivation-side constraint on theta wholly independent of A_omega — the first the arc has had. IT FAILS, and cleanly. The k_mu = 0 rows are the FIRST readings in this entire arc to pass the straddling necessary condition that all nine measured readings failed — and they then miss the A-free ratio by >= 889.593x. The common k = 0 solution is excluded independently: it forces theta = 0 at BOTH anchors, so S has the same sign at both, contradicting the MEASURED sign flip. THE CONCLUSION IS A FORK, NOT A REFUTATION of either object: either (a) the T5 channel's u is NOT the substrate-matched Murakami meridian despite the two carrying identical documentation — in which case T5's 'log meridian holonomy' wording is misleading and theta needs a stated alternative definition; or (b) the T4-inverted theta values are incompatible with the proved meridian quantization. Both branches are cheap to settle and either one is worth more than another reading. Scope (a): nothing here refutes the Murakami theorem (proved) or the T5 assembly (proved); it reports that their CONJUNCTION is falsifiable and false. No A_omega derived, no theta proposed, nothing wired.
